name: struction
description: Engine and package aware authoring for Struction JSONC definitions and scenes.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The language host executes the game's registered Rust packages.

struction.projectRoot.description: Project data directory, relative to the workspace folder or absolute. Empty discovers project/ or apps/playground/project/.

struction.hostPath.description: Language host executable, absolute or on PATH. Relative paths containing a separator resolve from the workspace folder.

struction.hostArgs.description: Arguments before the project directory. No shell is used. Custom game hosts implement describe/analyze with the game's own registrations.

struction.validationDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before analyzing changed buffers.
